speaker: Doctor
text: That is a concerning progression; have you noticed any increased thirst, frequent urination, or blurred vision accompanying these dietary changes and behavioral shifts? Additionally, have you experienced any new-onset headaches, confusion, or difficulty speaking recently?

text: My main symptom is Inappropriate behavior. I also have Disinterest in family interactions, Craving for specific foods, Significant weight gain, Apathy, Blunted affect.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Frontotemporal Dementia (behavioral variant).
